sections.content: The canonical package defines VDD semantic verification and Quick Dev recovery for auditable independent execution.
sections.title: Package

sections.content: Normative requirements cover semantic contracts, real execution, independent judging, layered evidence, exact Acceptance ID coverage, recovery, profiles, and self-hosted validation.
sections.title: Requirements

sections.content: Exact cover is many-to-many. Artifact authority, evidence snapshots, identity construction, and promotion ownership are resolved; comparator policy, judge operations, rollback probes, stop-loss, and reuse details remain deferred.
